meta.methodology: SEC 424B2, 424B3, 424B5, and FWP filings are parsed into note issuance events and deduplicated across pricing term sheets and prospectus supplements. Series are grouped by fund, coupon, and maturity year, then enriched with a verified CUSIP where the filing supplies one. Gross issuance is not adjusted for tenders or open-market repurchases unless a later source explicitly supplies the change; outstanding status is therefore labeled as a candidate. FINRA EndOfDayPriceYield observations are executed-trade closes, not dealer quotes.
